description: d_min=0.08 â€” late-time production (months 48-73) flattens to 650-750 bbl, well above exponential decay at 5%. Terminal decline likely 7-10%, trying 8%.

b_initial=1.0 â€” optimizer converges to b=1.33 from b_initial=0.5, but R2_outsample=-7.76 suggests poor extrapolation. Starting b closer to fitted value may find better local minimum for holdout period.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 â€” first gives qi~8819 but optimizer finds qi=4943. Averaging top 3 months gives initial guess closer to optimum, may improve convergence.
di_initial=0.7 â€” fitted di=0.589 from di_initial=0.5. Trying higher initial guess to explore different convergence path, may better capture early steep decline.

outlier_threshold=0.25 â€” months 35 (682), 48 (470), 58 (285) are clear operational shutdowns 50-70% below trend. Current threshold 0.494 only rejects 1.85% of data. Tighter threshold should remove more shutdown months and improve fit.
outlier_window=5 â€” current window=3 too narrow to detect shutdown months (35, 48, 58) against declining trend. Wider window provides more robust rolling median baseline for outlier detection.

significance_threshold=0.35 â€” fit uses 53 of 60 months, meaning decline detected at ~month 7. Lower threshold should detect decline earlier, capturing the initial steep drop from 8819 to give optimizer more data for the hyperbolic shape.

smoothing_window=3 â€” current window=6 from random ablation heavily smooths data. Reducing to 3 preserves more natural decline curvature, especially the sharp early drop from 8819 to 3000s in first 10 months.
smoothing_window=4 â€” window=6 gives MAPE 0.0373 with 53 fit months, window=3 gave 0.0379 with 58 months. Window=4 may balance smoothing with data preservation.
